name: Franschhoek
tagline: Wine tram through the Cape's food valley
summary: Franschhoek is a pretty valley town founded by French Huguenots, now the food and wine capital of the Cape Winelands. Hop between estates on the Wine Tram, eat at some of South Africa's best restaurants, see the Huguenot Monument and drive the mountain passes.
seasonNote: Harvest in February and March; winters are wet and cool but cosy.
arrival: About 1 hour 15 minutes by car from Cape Town.
gettingAround: The Wine Tram or a driver between estates; do not drink and drive.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 10 to 15 percent in restaurants and a few rand to car guards.
foodTip: Cape Malay flavours, trout and long tasting menus with Méthode Cap Classique sparkling wine.
